## 1.0.1

Fixes Morphe Manager bundle loading: adds Android DEX and bundle name/version metadata. Verified with Manager 2.3.0's patcher on Android 35. Gameplay patch logic and the target (stock Tracket 0.9.38, versionCode 237) are unchanged.

This is a client-side patch, not a genuine Google Play purchase. Servers may still refuse the account. Please support the original developer.
